# Standardized Contracts Directory

> A searchable, filterable register of widely-used standardized contracts: jointly-drafted, market-wide forms like Bonterms, Common Paper, oneNDA, EU SCCs, ISDA, FIDIC, and AIA, tagged by jurisdiction and category.

Single-page directory, no build step, no backend. Runs entirely client-side.

## Contents
- A tagged list of standardized/market-standard contract forms used across industries: NDAs, cloud/SaaS terms, financial derivatives master agreements, construction contracts, data transfer agreements, and more.
- Each entry is tagged by jurisdiction and category and links to the official source for that form.

## Primary page
- [Standardized Contracts Directory](https://nkostelnik.github.io/standardized-contracts-directory/): the full directory.
